bio.text: Tom Sullivan, a Democrat, has represented Colorado Senate District 27, which includes Arapahoe and Douglas counties, since January 9, 2023.
He served in the Colorado House of Representatives before joining the Senate.

According to Ballotpedia, Sullivan served in the U.S. Air Force from 1974 to 1977, earned a degree in journalism and accounting from Metropolitan State College of Denver in 1988, and worked with the U.S. Postal Service and the American Postal Workers Union.
